# etence

> > Russian IT company specializing in custom software development, BI platforms (etence.analytics, etence.OCR), and government/enterprise digital transformation with expertise in GOST/ISO standards compliance.

etence is a development studio with 6+ years of experience, 20+ team members, and 35+ completed projects spanning business intelligence, GIS, logistics, and media analytics. The site features extensive technical documentation on Russian GOST standards, CI/CD implementation, system architecture methodologies, and R&D processes for enterprise clients.

## Key Topics

- GOST standards (ГОСТ 19, ГОСТ 34)
- ISO/IEC software engineering standards
- CI/CD and DevOps automation
- etence.analytics (BI platform)
- etence.OCR
- R&D (НИОКР) and innovation processes
- Software documentation (ESPD)
- System architecture and design methodology
- Agile and Scrum
- GitLab, Kubernetes, Argo CD
- Keycloak and OpenID Connect
- NestJS and TypeScript backend
- Mobile development (iOS, Android)
- Russian IT compliance and certification

- [etence](https://etence.me): Homepage: Russian IT company creating digital products for business/gov

## Software Documentation Standards

- [Документация на ПО: структура, ГОСТ 34/19, ISO и IEEE](https://etence.me/resources/materials/dokumentaciya-na-programmnoe-obespechenie): Software documentation guide: GOST 34/19, ISO/IEEE lifecycle standards
- [Эксплуатационная документация на ПО](https://etence.me/resources/materials/ekspluatacionnaya-dokumentaciya-na-po): Operational docs guide: GOST standards, structure, and business value
- [ГОСТ и ISO: в чём разница и как унифицировать документацию](https://etence.me/resources/materials/sopostavlenie-gost-iso-dokumentaciya): GOST vs ISO mapping: terminology, structure, certification alignment
- [Правила оформления программной документации по ГОСТ](https://etence.me/resources/materials/gost-dokumentaciya-oformlenie): GOST documentation formatting: title pages, sections, appendices, refs
- [Как оформить «Описание программы» по ГОСТ 19.402-78](https://etence.me/resources/materials/opisanie-struktury-programmy): Program description per GOST 19.402-78: structure, HLD/LLD mapping
- [Как оформить changelog и перечень доработок в Agile-проектах](https://etence.me/resources/materials/changelog-i-perechen-dorabotok-v-agile): Changelog & release notes in Agile: structure, traceability, trust

## System Design & Architecture

- [Методология проектирования систем](https://etence.me/materials/metodologiya-proektirovaniya-sistem): System design methodology: GOST, ISO, CMMI standards and architecture
- [Внедрение CI/CD за 5 дней](https://etence.me/resources/materials/vnedrenie-ci-cd): CI/CD implementation in 5 days: GitLab, Kubernetes, Argo CD, zero downtime
- [Как организовать систему хранения исходного кода](https://etence.me/materials/hranenie-iskhodnogo-koda): Source code storage: Git server, roles, access, backup, commit delivery
- [Keycloak и OpenID Connect: централизованная авторизация](https://etence.me/resources/materials/keycloak-openid-ldap-avtorizatsiya): Keycloak SSO setup: OpenID Connect, LDAP/AD, Jira/GitLab integration
- [ИТ-аудит: что это, виды и этапы](https://etence.me/resources/materials/audit-it): IT audit guide: security, infrastructure, compliance, audit types/stages

## R&D & Innovation

- [Что такое R&D (НИОКР) в IT](https://etence.me/resources/materials/niokr-i-rnd-v-it): R&D (НИОКР) in IT: innovation process, stages, business value, FAQ
